NetWorthCategoryLiabilities_interestRate.name: NetWorthCategoryLiabilities_interestRate_ck
NetWorthCategoryLiabilities_interestRate.value:
("NetWorthCategoryLiabilities"."type" = 'LOAN' AND "NetWorthCategoryLiabilities"."interestRate" IS NOT NULL)
           OR ("NetWorthCategoryLiabilities"."type" <> 'LOAN' AND "NetWorthCategoryLiabilities"."interestRate" IS NULL)

NetWorthValues_exactlyOneCategory_ck.name: NetWorthValues_exactlyOneCategory_ck
NetWorthValues_exactlyOneCategory_ck.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "NetWorthValues"."categoryAssetId"     IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN "NetWorthValues"."categoryLiabilityId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN "NetWorthValues"."categoryOptionId"    IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) = 1
